giftGuide.title: How to choose a handmade crochet gift
giftGuide.description: Choose handmade crochet gifts in India: compare accessories, toys and decor, plan your budget, and check customisation, suitability and delivery before ordering.
giftGuide.intro: The best handmade gift feels like them. Think about what they wear, carry or love having around, then find a crochet piece that fits their everyday. Here is a simple way to choose with care.

sections.title: Little gifts, big smiles
sections.text: For a birthday, a thank-you or a just-because surprise, consider a charm, keychain or hair accessory that suits their style. Check the dimensions, attachment and available colours on the product page, not just the styled photograph.

sections.title: For their home or collection
sections.text: Think handmade characters for a collector, or decor for someone who loves styling a space. Check size, materials, care and what is included; photo props may not be part of the gift. For children, confirm age suitability, construction and small parts with Luvia. Never assume a handmade toy is baby-safe.

link.label: Read materials, sizing and care FAQs

sections.title: Find your comfort budget
sections.text: Start with an amount that feels right, then check your selected colour or variant, quantity and shipping. The final checkout total matters more than a starting price. Bestsellers offer ideas, but choose what fits your person rather than popularity alone.

sections.title: Make it personal
sections.text: Have a favourite colour or a little message in mind? Share the product link and your idea before ordering. Customisation, gift packaging, messages and direct delivery need confirmation, including any price or dispatch changes. They are not automatically included.

sections.title: Give it time to arrive
sections.text: Share the occasion date and destination before paying. Dispatch means handing the parcel to the courier, not arrival at your recipient's door. Check current India dispatch and shipping terms. International gifts require an individual quote; Indian checkout and shipping offers do not apply.

sections.title: Gifting for a group?
sections.text: For return gifts, a team or a celebration, share your product ideas, quantity, budget, destination and required date. We will confirm available designs, colours, personalisation, pricing and timelines individually. An enquiry does not confirm an order.

link.label: Enquire about bulk orders and corporate gifting

sections.title: One last check, then gift with care
sections.text: Review materials, dimensions, care, your selected variant, availability and the return policy. Ask about anything missing before payment, especially for a custom or date-sensitive gift. Customer Love shares selected, consented stories: testimonials, not independent ratings or a guarantee.

toySafetyNotice: Toy suitability depends on age, construction and any small or detachable parts. Ask Luvia to confirm these details before ordering for a child. Do not assume a handmade crochet toy is suitable for babies or young children.

brandStory.title: The Story Behind Luvia
brandStory.subtitle: From corporate leadership to a life rooted in craft.
brandStory.description: Meet Tanushree Mithal, the founder of Luvia Creations, and discover her journey from 20 years in corporate leadership to a passion for handmade craft.
brandStory.intro: After 20 years in the corporate world, including several leadership roles, Tanushree Mithal chose a new direction: following her creative passion and building a brand with local artisans at its heart.

founderNote.title: A note from our founder
founderNote.text: I wanted to give my passion a purpose: to create something meaningful while celebrating the skill of local artisans. Luvia is my way of bringing those hopes together. My wish is that every piece you choose brings a little of the care behind it into your everyday life.

teaser.title: The driving force behind Luvia
teaser.text: After a 20-year corporate career, Tanushree Mithal chose to follow her creative passion. Discover how that new chapter became Luvia, a brand rooted in handmade craft and a purpose to support local artisans.

sections.title: A new chapter, shaped by passion
paragraphs: For 20 years, Tanushree built her career in the corporate world, holding several leadership positions along the way. It was a journey of responsibility, dedication and working with people. But alongside that career was a desire to make room for something more personal: her passion for creativity.

She decided to take that passion seriously and give it a purpose beyond herself. She wanted to build something that would celebrate handmade work and support local artisans. That decision marked the beginning of Luvia.

sections.title: Handmade, with people at its heart
paragraphs: Luvia was born from a simple belief: things made by hand deserve to be valued, and so do the people who make them. Tanushree envisioned a brand that could bring thoughtful design and the skill of local artisans together, with care at the centre of every creation.

Crochet asks us to slow down. Every stitch takes time, patience and attention. The small variations in a handmade piece are part of its character, a reminder that it was made by a person, not simply produced in a line.

sections.title: Little creations, meaningful connections
paragraphs: From a cheerful accessory to a thoughtful gift or a little detail for your home, Luvia's pieces are made to bring the warmth of handmade craft into everyday life. They invite us to choose with care, give with thought and find joy in the details.

For Tanushree, Luvia is a new way to bring passion and purpose together: following a creative calling while working towards opportunities for local artisans. This is the journey we are building, one handmade creation at a time.

brandStory.closing: Luvia Creations - Made with love. Rooted in craft. Created to connect.

questions: Are your product images generated using AI?

Some lifestyle and styled images are generated or enhanced using AI, using photographs of our actual handmade products as references. AI helps illustrate different settings and use cases, such as gifting, styling or hanging a product; it is not how the physical product is made. These images are illustrative and may not reproduce every stitch, colour or proportion exactly. People, backgrounds and props in styled scenes are not necessarily real or included with your order. Please refer to the selected product's description, materials, dimensions and What's included details rather than judging size from a styled scene. Handmade pieces can have small variations, and screen colours can differ. If you would like to see an actual product photograph or clarify a detail before ordering, ask us on WhatsApp.
How do I place an order?

Choose the product and variant, add your items to the cart, and save your contact and delivery address. Review your coupon, shipping and total, then pay securely through Razorpay. Your online order is confirmed after payment verification; you do not need to confirm it again on WhatsApp. Guest ordering is available; email signup is optional. Saved delivery details stay with your cart for up to 30 days and are visible to Luvia for order fulfilment. Use WhatsApp for help or assisted ordering if online checkout is unavailable. Adding items or sending a message does not confirm an order.
Can I request different colours or customisation?
Ask us on WhatsApp with the product link and your preferences. Options depend on the product; we will confirm whether the request is possible, along with any price or timing changes.
How does Luvia package handmade crochet gifts?

Luvia uses premium sustainable packaging, including reusable cotton pouches and recycled paper and card for selected products. Our handmade crochet gifts and accessories are thoughtfully presented with care for Mother Earth. Packaging varies by product. Ask us about gift packaging or messages before ordering; availability and any extra cost must be confirmed.
Can I order from outside India?

International orders are by enquiry, not online checkout. Contact us with your destination country, postal code, product links and quantity. Availability, supported payment options, shipping charges, tracking availability and estimated dispatch and delivery timelines are confirmed before payment. Indian checkout shipping offers do not apply. Import duties, taxes and clearance charges may apply; responsibility will be explained in your quote. Customs may delay delivery. Cancellation, returns, refunds and any return-shipping costs will be explained before payment, subject to applicable consumer rights.
Do you ship across India, and how much does shipping cost?

We ship across India. For online checkout, shipping is free when the items subtotal after coupon discounts is at least ₹500. Below ₹500, the current saved courier estimate rounded up to the next ₹10 applies, or ₹100 if no current estimate is available. Review the shipping charge and total before you pay. Delivery time after dispatch depends on your location.
When will my order be dispatched?

For delivery within India, dispatch is within 5 days of receiving the order, or earlier. Dispatch means handing the parcel to the courier, not delivery. International dispatch and delivery estimates are confirmed separately in your quote, and customs clearance may cause delays.
How do I pay?

Use Proceed to payment after reviewing your delivery address, coupon, shipping and total. Razorpay processes the payment, and your online order is confirmed after payment verification. If online checkout is unavailable, contact Luvia for assisted ordering and confirm payment instructions before sending money. Never share your card PIN, OTP or passwords in a message.
Are shipping charges included in the displayed price?

Product prices are in Indian rupees and exclude shipping. Any shipping charge is shown in your checkout total before payment. Variant prices can differ; the price shown for your selected variant applies.
What materials and sizes are used?
Check the individual product details for confirmed materials and dimensions. Information varies by product; ask us to confirm any missing details, suitability or sizing before ordering.
How should I care for my crochet product?
Follow the care instructions on the individual product page where provided. If instructions are missing or you are unsure, contact us before washing; care depends on the materials and construction.
